title: "About"
---

I'm Sean Plummer, an applied mathematician/statistician working on:

- singular learning theory and Bayesian asymptotics  
- geometry-aware variational inference  
- fairness in statistical and machine learning models  
- statistical principles for understanding and evaluating LLMs — from generalization and uncertainty to fairness and reliability

This site, **Asymptotically Correct**, is named after our grad school trivia team and doubles as my evolving research notebook.
